Pillar 1

🔀 Decomposition

Solving any big problem directly is difficult. Decomposition means breaking a large problem into smaller parts, so each part feels manageable.

🏠

Building a House

Don't build the whole house at once. First plan, then foundation, then walls, then roof — one step at a time.

📖

Exam Preparation

Don't study the whole syllabus at once! Subject → Chapter → Topic → Points — break it down and study.

🍕

Making Pizza

Dough, sauce, toppings, baking — when broken into separate steps, it becomes much easier to handle.

Pillar 2

🔍 Pattern Recognition

Pattern Recognition means finding repeating things. Once you understand a pattern, you can apply the same solution elsewhere too!

🌦️

Weather

Dark clouds gather, the wind turns cold — recognize the pattern, and you know rain is on the way!

📐

Math Patterns

2, 4, 6, 8… understand the pattern and you can easily predict the next number. The even numbers pattern!

🔤

Language

"Cat, bat, rat, mat" — recognize the "at" pattern, and reading new words becomes easy!

🎮 Spot the Pattern!

Look at the sequence and choose the correct number/symbol to replace "?".

Pillar 3

🎯 Abstraction

Abstraction means keeping what's important and ignoring the rest. When solving a problem, focus only on the details that truly matter.

🗺️

Map

A map doesn't show every house in detail — just roads and important places. That's abstraction!

📱

App Icons

The WhatsApp icon is just a phone + speech bubble. Inside there are millions of lines of code — but you only see the icon.

🚗

Driving a Car

You don't need to know engine mechanics — just steering, brakes, and accelerator. The rest is abstracted away!

🎮 Essential vs. Irrelevant — You Decide!

Pillar 4

📋 Algorithm

An Algorithm is a clear step-by-step plan — like a recipe. If the steps are in the right order, the result will always be the same!

🧁

Cake Recipe

Ingredients → Mix → Bake → Cool → Decorate. Follow this order and you'll get a perfect cake every time.

🏧

ATM Withdrawal

Insert card → Enter PIN → Enter amount → Confirm → Take cash. That's an algorithm!

🎮

Game Logic

Player jumps → Check collision → Add score → Next level. All games run on algorithms.
